what: A holds two rows under Bo's ids that Bo never signed: a case at seq 10 and a note at seq 9. Bo's signed rows take both ids on A, and B refuses both of A's. Each merge rejects the two ids, and `rejected` lists them by id, the seq compared as a number: seq 9 before seq 10, though the case is met first and "10" sorts before "9" as text (docs/format.md#report-set).
